skill.description: Generate images with Flux 2 Klein on RunComfy. The skill documents the 4B and 9B variants, prompt patterns, reference image guidance, and CLI invocation details.

skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, code fences, ellipses, and user-visible documentation links. I confirmed one low-risk outbound network behavior: the RunComfy CLI posts requests to model-api.runcomfy.net with the user bearer token. No prompt injection attempt, hidden persistence, arbitrary filesystem access, or system reconnaissance was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Tell users that prompts, reference URLs, and generated outputs are processed by RunComfy before they submit confidential material.
Require user confirmation before running RunComfy commands and recommend installing the CLI from the official package source.
Keep the token file owner-only and prefer RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or container environments.

content.value_statement: Fast image iteration needs model-specific prompts and clear variant choices. This skill guides Flux 2 Klein runs on RunComfy with practical settings, examples, and limits.
actual_capabilities: Invokes Flux 2 Klein 4B and 9B text-to-image endpoints through the RunComfy CLI.
Explains when to use 4B for fast concepts and 9B for polished output.
Provides prompt grammar for subject, action, scene, style, lighting, camera, and quality.
Documents reference image workflows for style transfer and guided composition.
Describes output polling, downloads, exit codes, and RunComfy privacy boundaries.
limitations: Requires a working RunComfy CLI installation and account token.
Native output is limited to about 2K resolution and a 16:9 aspect ratio.
Prompts above about 512 tokens can reduce image quality.
Heavy in-image text and multilingual signage may need a different image model.

use_cases.title: Live Creative Direction
use_cases.description: Use the 4B variant for rapid image drafts during art direction sessions.

use_cases.title: Product Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Create fast product scenes, then rerun the best prompt on 9B for detail.

use_cases.title: Brand Style Exploration
use_cases.description: Apply aligned reference images to keep a consistent look across asset variations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a fast first image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B to generate a quick concept image of [subject] in [scene] with [style]. Keep the prompt concise.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Product Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a product visual for [product] with [lighting], [surface], [camera angle], and [brand mood]. Use 9B with about 25 steps.

prompt_templates.title: Use Reference Styling
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced style transfer with reference images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use up to four aligned reference images to guide the style. Keep the same composition, then change [specific element] to [new detail].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Variant Selection
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare 4B and 9B for this image task: [goal]. Recommend steps, size, reference image strategy, and when to switch models.

output_examples.input: Create a fast concept image for a ceramic mug in a calm studio scene.
output_examples.output: A concise subject-first prompt, 4B variant recommendation, square size, and a note to rerun on 9B for final texture.

output_examples.input: Make a wide poster-style image for a product launch.
output_examples.output: A wide-format prompt using the 16:9 cap, suggested dimensions, 9B polish settings, and composition guidance.

output_examples.input: Use reference images to keep the same bottle shape but change the label color.
output_examples.output: A conditional edit prompt that preserves composition, lighting, silhouette, table, and shadow while changing the label.

best_practices: Start with the subject, then add action, scene, style, lighting, camera, and quality details.
Use 4B for quick exploration, then use 9B with about 25 steps for final polish.
Keep reference images visually aligned so the model receives one clear style direction.
anti_patterns: Do not mix conflicting style directions in one prompt.
Do not exceed the approximate 512 token prompt limit.
Do not request 4K output or extreme aspect ratios from this model.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates images with Flux 2 Klein through RunComfy text-to-image endpoints.

faq.question: Does it need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI must be installed and authenticated before generation works.

faq.question: Which variant should I choose?
faq.answer: Use 4B for fast concepting and 9B when you need more detail in the final image.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents workflows with up to four aligned reference images.

faq.question: Is it good for text inside images?
faq.answer: It can handle some text, but complex typography may require a stronger text-rendering image model.

faq.question: Where are outputs saved?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI downloads generated output files into the output directory chosen for the run.
